name: get_next_question
description: Get the next practice question due for review and open an attempt on it. Returns attempt_id, question_id, question, question_type, options (option letter to text) and rungs_available (how many written hints exist), or a sentence when nothing is due. It never contains the answer or the hints.

domain.description: Preferred subject, such as math, science, chemistry or english. Omit for any subject.
